*Extracting ultra-high resolution vegetation and water metrics from UAV orthomosaics*

## 1 Objective

Ingest UAV orthomosaic bands (Near-Infrared, Red, and Green) and compute two foundational environmental metrics: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI).

<div class="text-center my-3">
  <img src="../reference/figures/02_metric_ndvi.png" class="img-fluid rounded border shadow-sm" alt="Study Area Orthomosaic and Vegetation Metrics" width="85%">
</div>

---

## 2 Functions from `drones4health`

| Variable / Target | Function | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Multi-Band Stack Ingestion** | `d4h_read_stack()` | Ingests multi-band raster stacks and verifies that required spectral bands are present, halting with an informative error if any band is missing. |
| **Vegetation Canopy** | `d4h_ndvi()` | Quantifies photosynthetic vigor and vegetative canopy cover from Near-Infrared and Red bands. |
| **Water Detection** | `d4h_ndwi()` | Delineates open standing water surfaces and moisture accumulation from Green and Near-Infrared bands. |
| **Unified Visualization** | `d4h_plot()` | Unified visualization: renders static `ggplot2` maps when `interactive = FALSE`, or interactive web maps via `mapview` when `interactive = TRUE`. |

---

## 3 Workflow

### 3.1 Libraries

We load the core spatial packages and dependencies required for drone remote sensing analysis:

```{r}
library(drones4health)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
```

### 3.2 Spatial Data Preparation & Automated Metadata Ingestion

In operational drone processing pipelines, manual inspection and coordinate extraction of individual bands is unneeded. In `drones4health`, all physical dimensions (column/row widths, total pixel counts), Ground Sampling Distance (GSD, e.g. 9.92 cm/px), coordinate systems (EPSG:32718 / WGS 84 UTM 18S), and bounding boxes (177.014 ha | 1,609.5 m x 1,099.8 m) are automatically ingested internally by `d4h_read_stack()` and reported in downstream functions like `d4h_executive_summary()`.

```{r}
# 1. Define paths to drone orthomosaic channels
path_rgb <- "img/Ohuay_D.tif"    # High-resolution RGB orthomosaic
path_nir <- "img/Ohuay_NIR.tif"  # Dedicated 16-bit Near-Infrared channel
path_r   <- "img/Ohuay_R.tif"    # Dedicated 16-bit Red channel
path_g   <- "img/Ohuay_G.tif"    # Dedicated 16-bit Green channel
```

```{r}
# Option B: Ingest a multi-band stacked raster with automated band and metadata validation
# If any required band is missing, d4h_read_stack halts with an informative error
# r_stack <- d4h_read_stack(
#   file_path      = "img/Ohuay_Stack.tif",
#   required_bands = c("NIR", "Red", "Green")
# )
```

### 3.3 Metric Calculation: NDVI & NDWI

We compute the two environmental indices directly from the raster bands:

```{r}
# 1. Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)
# Formula: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
r_ndvi <- d4h_ndvi(nir = path_nir, red = path_r)

# 2. Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)
# Formula: (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR)
r_ndwi <- d4h_ndwi(green = path_g, nir = path_nir)
```

### 3.4 Unified Visualization (Static & Interactive)

`d4h_plot()` provides a single unified interface: setting `interactive = FALSE` outputs a publication-ready `ggplot2` figure, while `interactive = TRUE` renders an interactive `mapview` web map:

```{r}
# 1. Static publication-ready cartography via ggplot2 (interactive = FALSE)
p_static <- d4h_plot(
  x           = r_ndvi,
  interactive = FALSE,
  palette     = "viridis",
  title       = "UAV Canopy Density (NDVI)",
  limits      = c(-0.1, 0.9)
)
print(p_static)

# 2. Interactive web map exploration via mapview (interactive = TRUE)
m_interactive <- d4h_plot(
  x           = r_ndvi,
  interactive = TRUE,
  palette     = "viridis",
  title       = "UAV Canopy Density (NDVI)"
)
m_interactive
```

## 4 Results & Executive Reporting

### 4.1 Multi-Moment Executive Summary

We generate an automated executive summary evaluating spatial moments (mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, median, interquartile range), Tukey outlier fences, and thematic stratum distributions for both NDVI and NDWI:

```{r}
# Generate multi-moment executive summary with direct multi-sheet Excel export
exec_summary_case01 <- d4h_executive_summary(
  raster_in   = list(r_ndvi, r_ndwi),
  by          = "general",
  out_xlsx    = "salidas/Executive_Summary_Case01_Metrics.xlsx",
  sample_size = 1000000,
  digits      = 3
)
print(exec_summary_case01)
```

### 4.2 Excel Export Structure & Sheet Previews

The workbook exported to `salidas/Executive_Summary_Case01_Metrics.xlsx` contains 3 dedicated sheets:

1. **`Global_Summary`**: Statistical moments, spatial extent, pixel counts, and coefficient of variation.
2. **`Thematic_Strata`**: Percentage and surface area in hectares partitioned by biophysical threshold ranges.
3. **`Outliers_Diagnostics`**: Tukey lower/upper fences, outlier counts, and distribution diagnoses.
